source: Read-only SQL against the live paiflow.xyz application database (Railway project paiflow, environment staging, service Postgres). Window: rows created on or after 2026-09-07T00:00:00.000Z, Stellar testnet. Generated by scripts/instawards-metrics.ts.

uniqueFlowsDeployed.definition: COUNT(*) FROM Deployment WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED' AND createdAt >= 2026-09-07
uniqueFlowsDeployed.note: 35 distinct Flow ids; a flow deployed twice counts twice, matching 'deployments' in the SOW wording

contractExecutionsEventsPublished.definition: COUNT(*) FROM ContractEvent joined to deployments created in the window
contractExecutionsEventsPublished.note: Rows the app decoded and published to the live feed. On-chain each swap transaction emits 12 contract events, so the raw on-chain count is higher; the app-recorded figure is the one reported.

uniqueSwapperFlowsExecutedOnTestnet.definition: COUNT(DISTINCT deploymentId) FROM ContractEvent WHERE payload.topics[0] = 'swap'
uniqueSwapperFlowsExecutedOnTestnet.note: Each is a confirmed deployment whose swapper emitted a swap event through the Soroswap router, across 24 swap transactions; listed in d1/14-swapper-flows.json

distinctWalletsDeploying.definition: COUNT(DISTINCT sourceAccount) FROM Deployment WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED' AND createdAt >= 2026-09-07

contractWasmUploaded.definition: Swapper WASM e9482ff07fcf4791aa3f8deebeda6159081a04f13e8ac63c28e91b7f80b23d1a on testnet; ContractTemplate SWAPPER/TESTNET row points at it and every public-app swap flow instantiates it

publicTestnetUrlLive.definition: Public app on Stellar testnet, reachable with no account via the sandbox

demoVideoPublished.definition: SOW §5.1 week 4 deliverable; the D1 screen recording is not the demo video

distinctWalletsConnected.definition: COUNT(DISTINCT metadata.address) FROM AuditLog WHERE action = 'WALLET_CONNECT' AND createdAt >= 2026-09-07

deploymentsAllTime.definition: COUNT(*) FROM Deployment WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED', no window
